params._params: Each pool swap params. I.e. [SWAP_N][idxFrom, idxTo, swapType] Swap types: 1 for a stableswap `exchange`, 2 for stableswap `exchange_underlying`, 3 for a cryptoswap `exchange`, 4 for a cryptoswap `exchange_underlying`, 5 for factory metapools with lending base pool `exchange_underlying`, 6 for factory crypto-meta pools underlying exchange (`exchange` method in zap), 7-11 for wrapped coin (underlying for lending or fake pool) -> LP token "exchange" (actually `add_liquidity`), 12-14 for LP token -> wrapped coin (underlying for lending pool) "exchange" (actually `remove_liquidity_one_coin`) 15 for WETH -> ETH "exchange" (actually deposit/withdraw) Refs:  https://etherscan.deth.net/address/0x99a58482BD75cbab83b27EC03CA68fF489b5788f
params._pools: Array of pools for swaps via zap contracts.
params._route: Array of [initial token, pool, token, pool, token, ...]
